description: Continuous competitor monitoring (paid plans: Starter 2 apps weekly, Pro 15 apps daily). Manage the watchlist and the alert destination; digests of NEW 1-2★ reviews and NEW/RISING pain points are pushed to a Slack / Discord / any https webhook. action: list | add | remove | set_webhook | test.

appId.description: for add/remove: store URL, iOS/Mac id, Android package or Steam appid

store.description: optional — inferred from appId (App Store URL or 5-12 digit id → ios, Play URL / package → android, Steam URL or 1-4 digit appid → steam); iOS and Mac App Store share the same URL shape, so pass "macos" explicitly for Mac apps. steam: details/search only for now — mining/reviews return steam_reviews_unavailable

webhookUrl.description: for set_webhook (or add): https URL, e.g. a Slack incoming webhook or Discord channel webhook

name: watch_competitors
title: Watch competitors (alerts)
